name: reversal_multiasset_4y_skip1y_k3
hypothesis: Across a broad multi-asset universe, the assets most beaten-down over years 2-4 (excluding the last 12 months) mean-revert and outperform over the next month.

name: reversal_multiasset_5y_skip1y_k3
hypothesis: Same multi-asset reversal at the full 5y De Bondt-Thaler horizon (years 2-5, skip last 12mo).

name: reversal_multiasset_3y_skip1y_k3
hypothesis: Shorter 3y reversal horizon (years 2-3, skip last 12mo) to gauge horizon sensitivity.

name: reversal_multiasset_4y_skip1y_k2_quarterly
hypothesis: Concentrated (top 2) quarterly-rebalanced 4y reversal to cut turnover and test whether the effect survives lower trading frequency.

name: reversal_equityregions_4y_skip1y_k2
hypothesis: Equity-region-only reversal: rotate toward the cheapest regions (US large, US tech, developed-ex-US, EM) on a 4y skip-1y horizon.

name: reversal_multiasset_4y_NOSKIP_k3_control
hypothesis: CONTROL: identical to spec 1 but with no skip-recent gap, i.e. plain inverted momentum. Pre-registered to measure how much the skip-recent gap actually changes behaviour and orthogonality.
